config.selection: smallest legal candidate with maximum tuning field Linf error <= tau
config.no_qualifying_rank: selected_rank=null; use largest legal rank only for development diagnosis
config.timing_policy: Single pass perf_counter; FOM references reused across ranks, each ROM independently assembles; no online matrix cache; no basis updates. Timers include full-dimensional assembly, projection, reconstruction and residual. Verification, evaluation and persistence are separate development overhead.

definitions.relative_l2: Euclidean norm(ROM-FOM)/norm(FOM); uniform area weights cancel
definitions.zero_denominator: 0 if numerator is 0, otherwise null (undefined); absolute quantities retained

limitations: Development data only; no final test generated.
FOM is a floating-point discrete reference, not continuous truth.
Single pass timing is noisy; no general speedup claim.
Target met on tuning points does not guarantee the parameter domain.
